items.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway (ESA) relative path traversal in the AMP attachment engine lets an unauthenticated attacker write arbitrary files and execute commands as root; Cisco confirms active in-the-wild exploitation and CISA added it to the KEV catalog on Oct 14.

MariaDB server remote code execution via the #mysql50# table-name bypass prefix, affecting 10.6.1 through 13.0.2 releases; disclosed Oct 16, with fixed versions published including 10.6.28, 11.8.9 and 13.0.2.

iFlytek astron-agent agentic workflow platform ships unsandboxed Python execution in its default code-node path, allowing an authenticated low-privilege tenant to run code as root and cross tenant boundaries; fixed in 1.1.2.

ZoneMinder OS command injection: downloadEvents() wraps a user-controlled monitor name in manual quoting instead of escapeshellarg, letting a privileged user execute arbitrary commands as the web server user; fixed in 1.38.3.
Hitachi Vantara Remot Ops Agent 1.60–2.0: when the default self-signed certificate is used, an attacker can forge JWT access tokens and bypass login to gain administrative access to the application.
